objectives.statement: Recognize the meanings of common time, frequency, and place adverbs.
Place frequency adverbs after the finite verb in simple main clauses.
Use time and place adverbs first in a main clause with the finite verb in second position.

notes: Merged A1 adverb lesson. Must teach common adverbs plus basic placement in simple main clauses without stealing the job of the later sentence-adverb lessons. Include V2 after initial time/place adverbs and avoid confusing time adverb da with conjunction når.
